Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionQueen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle. Features: Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further! Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration 50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats 20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeatShow morePublished byFuture Friends GamesDeveloped byFreshly Baked Games LLCRelease date10/30/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerXbox achievements XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

source.title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol ReferenceGamesTANUKI: Pon's Summer Releases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalAlcohol ReferenceLoadingTaking place over one sweltering summer... Deliver packagesHop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of Tanuki's four towns. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it'll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery.ActivitiesAs you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they'll invite you to a wide range of sports and activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine's restoration.Restore the shrine to former gloryBuild, upgrade and decorate the shrine with the money and items you earn through deliveries and activities. Get the shrine ready for the festival at the end of summer!Four Major TownsExplore four major towns, lovingly inspired by Kyoto, Aomori, Sapporo, and Beppu. Each with their own quests and objectives.With the Tanuki Festival just around the corner, Pon must restore the shrine to its former glory. Help him earn cash, befriend the local townsfolk, and prep the shrine for the festival of a lifetime.BMX your way into the hearts of all the townsfolk as a mail delivery Tanuki! You've got one month to save up enough to restore the shrine for the Great Tanuki Festival. Deliver packages, compete in sports, make sushi, and much much more in Tanuki!Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 622 MBNintendo Switch 2: 779 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
